sections.Profile:
MiniZag, released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in November 1968, is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine with a dance and music theme. Designed by Ted Zale, the game features two zipper flippers, three pop bumpers, five mushroom bumpers, three slingshots, eleven rollover buttons, two kick-out holes, and a unique "Zagger Lane" with a captive ball. The right outlane includes a ball return gate, enhancing gameplay dynamics. The backglass showcases vibrant artwork by Jerry Kelley, contributing to the game's visual appeal.
